ValidationRule.description: Reimbursement Reason should be mandatory if "Total Reimbursed" is greater than 0
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Scam", Fraud_Total_Reimbursed__c > 0, ISBLANK( ReimbursementReason__c ) )
